trigger: Code to confirm closing the account (closing.js)
subject: Your code to close your VFTech account
preheader: Your code expires in ten minutes.
footer_note: You're getting this because someone signed in to your VF Tech account asked to close it.
body: Your code to close your VFTech account is {{code}}.
It expires in ten minutes and can be used once. If you didn't ask to close your account, ignore this email and nothing will change. Never share your code.
